name: Tony Blair
current_role: Executive chairman of the Tony Blair Institute for Global Change; member of the Executive Board of Trump's Board of Peace for Gaza (since January 2026)
summary: Tony Blair led the Labour Party from 1994 and was UK prime minister from 1997 to 2007, then served as the Middle East Quartet's envoy until 2015. His Tony Blair Institute for Global Change, founded in 2016, advises governments on technology and AI and has been funded heavily by Larry Ellison's foundation. In January 2026 the White House named him to the founding Executive Board of Trump's Board of Peace overseeing postwar Gaza.

connections.name: Larry Ellison
connections.description: Through the Larry Ellison Foundation, Ellison is the Tony Blair Institute's largest known funder: Lighthouse Reports counts $130 million given from 2021 to 2023 and $218 million more pledged. Totals differ between outlets (see Sources disagree). Lighthouse alleges the money turned the institute toward promoting Oracle's technology; that is one investigation's finding.

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: In January 2026 the White House named Blair to the founding Executive Board of the Board of Peace, which Trump chairs, to oversee Gaza's transition and reconstruction under Trump's plan; Blair said he was "honoured". Israel's government objected that the Gaza board was not coordinated with it.
